name: cbio-schw-ctf-synodos-2025
description: Whole exome sequencing of 30 patients with schwannomatosis-associated schwannomas, along with their matched normal samples. These data originate from the Synodos for Schwannomatosis project and were contributed by researchers supported by the Children's Tumor Foundation. The reprocessing of raw sequencing data is coordinated by the NF Open Science Initiative.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
